coverage.name: Montrose County
limitations: Checked 2026-10-10: the elections page posts three sample ballot styles, West End, City and State, with Spanish versions. All three were read. None has a county question. The Ballot Issue Notices page still has no 2026 material, and no participating-entities list is posted.

Not county questions and not housing: West End Health Service District Ballot Question 6A (organization of the district) and Ballot Issue 6B (a property tax for district operating and capital expenses), on the West End style only.

coverage.name: Montrose (city)
limitations: Participating (special coordinated municipal election, November 3, 2026, per the city).

Checked 2026-10-10: the county's City sample ballot lists City of Montrose Ballot Questions 2A (Elections), 2B (Term Limits), 2C (Police Chief) and 2D (City Clerk), which match the city's Proposed City Charter Amendments document. All four are excluded as not housing: moving the general municipal election from April of even-numbered years to November of even-numbered years; a limit of eight years of elected service in a councilmember's lifetime; council approval of the City Manager's decision to appoint and discharge the Police Chief; the same for the City Clerk.
